title: 🍽️ Multiple Food & Hospitality Openings in Lewis and Clark County - NewsBreak
text:
9 hours ago Helena’s food and hospitality scene is buzzing this month, with several great opportunities for folks who love serving others and working in a team setting. Whether you’re just starting out or ready to grow your own business, there’s something here for you.
Fresh Foods Department Internship – WinCo Foods Employer: WinCo Foods
Location: Helena, MT
Type: Internship
Help customers in the deli, seafood, and pizza areas while learning the ropes of food prep and safety. WinCo is an employee-owned company known for great benefits and a strong community focus.
Bakery Internship – WinCo Foods Employer: WinCo Foods
Location: Helena, MT
Type: Internship
If you love the smell of fresh bread and pastries, this bakery role could be a perfect fit. You’ll learn to mix, bake, and decorate while keeping the bakery running smoothly.
Chair & Room Rentals – Euclid Avenue Salon & Spa Employer: Euclid Avenue Salon & Spa
Location: Helena, MT
Type: Contract (Chair/Booth/Space Rental)
Stylists and massage pros can rent space in a modern, supportive salon with flexible terms. Great for anyone ready to grow their own client base with marketing and business support included.
Front Desk Associate – Residence Inn by Marriott Employer: Residence Inn by Marriott
Location: Helena, MT
Type: Part-time
Pay: $15.50–$16.00/hour
Be the friendly face greeting guests at one of Helena’s top hotels. Ideal for someone who enjoys multitasking and creating a welcoming experience for travelers.
If you’re ready to take the next step in your hospitality career, check out these listings and apply soon — good opportunities like these don’t stay open long!
Please note: Job listings change quickly. Some positions listed here may have already been filled, and links may no longer be active. Contact the employer or visit the official website directly for the most up-to-date information.
